meta.name: Pinball Playfield
meta.notes: Primary lights every insert, bumper cap, flipper rubber and the DMD glow against a black-and-chrome cabinet; accent only tints the painted playfield lines.

issues: Desktop hero: the playable table collapsed to ~290px (auto grid column + percentage width is circular), so the signature interaction reads as a sidebar widget and the bumper labels crowd the caps
Stress brand gallery: images that fail or lazy-load late leave seven flat black panes, and the 2x2/span-2 grid leaves holes for 7 and 8 items
Category 'modes' section is a plain left-aligned row of circles; with 3 categories (hotel) it leaves two thirds of the row empty and has nothing pinball about it besides chrome rings
Ramp of drop targets: thin hairline rails look like stray lines, and 3 products leave a dead gap on the right
Mobile: USP lanes stack into four tall, mostly empty blocks with full-height rails, which bloats the scroll
Typography and colour robustness are strong (Bungee Shade backglass, Orbitron DMD, blue hotel palette holds up); catalog page is solid
fixed: Gave the playfield an explicit cabinet column (clamp 340–520px) and a viewport-height-aware size, so the table is about 1.6x larger on desktop and the physics game is now the hero
Gallery panes get a brand-coloured starburst insert behind every image, broken images remove themselves, and grid-auto-flow:dense plus a 7-item span close the holes
Category modes are centred, sit on a chrome rail with a lit brand underglow, and labels are arrow-shaped inserts that chase-light in --c-primary (static under reduced motion)
Ramp rails are thicker chrome with a drop shadow and an animated lit dash, and 2 or 3 targets re-grid to fill the ramp with a steeper climb
Mobile lanes are compact rows with the arrow insert next to the copy and dashed separators
